card.name: Dried mushrooms
card.description: Dried mushrooms are a pantry shortcut to a deeper meal. Soak them, strain the liquid, and use both in rice, soup, or a slow sauce.

meet_the_maker.name: Mighty Cap Mushrooms
meet_the_maker.story: Mighty Cap began as Chris Batlle’s garage project and grew into a gourmet mushroom farm in Paso Robles. Small-batch cultivation and close relationships with chefs are at the heart of the business. Mushrooms deserve a hot pan, a little space, and enough patience to let them brown.
